_comment: Negative fixture: stale or unscoped signals are rejected or downgraded
_invariant: Stale scope metadata, expired graph snapshots, and unscoped signals must be rejected or downgraded. They must not contribute to positive recall ranking at the same tier as fresh, scoped signals.
_expected: Signals with stale freshness or unknown_scope status must be downgraded to the lowest ranking tier or rejected entirely. RecallPacket must disclose stale scope in unknown_scope entries.
_must_fail_if: stale signal ranks at same tier as fresh signal
stale_signals_must: carry stale or possibly_stale freshness label
rank below fresh signals of the same route
appear in unknown_scope or carry downgraded caveats
